sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B uses a hybrid architecture that combines Gated Delta Network linear attention with Full Attention layers. It also supports thinking mode and long context. Because the architecture is relatively new, use transformers>=4.57. For text-only fine-tuning, AutoModelForCausalLM loads the text language model (Qwen3_5ForCausalLM) without the vision tower.
